title: Coherence of actual finite and completed coefficient maps
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite field extension with ring of integers $A$, and $\varpi\in A$. On small pro-etale sites use $B_W=\varprojlim_n(A/\mathfrak m^{n+1})_W$, $R_W=B_W[1/\varpi]$, their actual structural maps, and the normalization predicates [def-per-localized-ordinary-pullback-data]. For all scheme morphisms $Z\xrightarrow hY\xrightarrow gX$, the predicate Coefficients holds: finite and completed composition and identity, the twice-projected equation, all quotient transitions and preservation of all constant scalars.

proof.text:
transport the constant-sheaf composition and identity equations through
pbcLevelConstantComparison. Its naturality transports every quotient transition.
Compose the defining projection equation twice; inverse-image compositor
naturality identifies the resulting finite components. Joint monicity gives
completed composition and identity without exchanging inverse image and a limit.
Finally evaluate the existing constant-scalar direct-image equation; its defining
adjunction unit gives exactly the displayed scalar formula.
